saas-tools.desc: Multi-tenant platform for law firms: a quoter with per-client branding and printable PDFs, KYC forms generated per firm, a risk matrix and OFAC/UN sanctions screening.
facts: Tenant isolation through a JWT claim and Postgres row-level security
Each client gets their own branding, catalog and form fields
Result to state: [placeholder: firms, volume or time saved]

play-store-mcp.desc: An MCP server that lets AI agents upload and promote Android releases on Google Play, built around a safety model.
facts: Every write is a dry run unless confirmed
Production only saves a draft: a human sends it for review
A maintained fork of an MIT project, with the original credited

DevocionalesAPI.desc: Multi-provider batch pipeline that generates the devotional corpus, with checkpointed, resumable runs.
facts: Dry-run mode prints a cost estimate before any call
Every LLM operation leaves an audit trail
Resumes from the last checkpoint after a failure

devocionales-ai-review.desc: LangGraph pipeline for translation, error detection, independent critic review, automated fixing and validation.
facts: Every AI-flagged finding is verified verbatim against the source
A separate critic reviews the fixer output

sanctions-check.desc: Automated SDN/OFAC screening for compliance professionals, as a web and desktop app.
facts: One codebase ships as a web app and a desktop app

florist.name: Catalogue site for a florist
